scripts.purge: npm run clean && rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules libs/*/node_modules
scripts.build:libs: npm run build:dataflow-core && npm run build:dataflow-nats
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:ws-gateway && npm run build:runner
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:apps
scripts.wait:libs: npm run wait:dataflow-core && npm run wait:dataflow-nats
scripts.dev:libs: concurrently -n '⚙️  dataflow-core','🔗 dataflow-nats' -c magenta,green "npm --workspace libs/dataflow-core run dev" "npm run wait:dataflow-core && npm --workspace libs/dataflow-nats run dev"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n '💻 frontend','🔌 ws-gateway','🚀 runner' -c cyan,yellow,blue "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ws-gateway" "npm run dev:runner"
scripts.dev: rm -rf libs/dataflow-core/dist && rm -rf libs/dataflow-nats/dist && npm run sync-envs && concurrently -n 'lib','app' -c redBright,gray "npm run dev:libs" "npm run wait:libs && npm run dev:apps"
